title: slopvac v3 rules output
description: The document that `slopvac rules --format json` prints. `slopvac explain RULE --format json` prints one entry of its `rules` list, described by `$defs/ExplainOutput`. Rule entries carry the qualified rule id and the facts the binary adds to the authoring shape in rule.schema.json: the category, the match kind, the documentation link and the severity after the configuration layers. This is an output document, so it is not valid input for a rule or category file. Unknown keys are errors, and keys that start with `x-` are ignored.

plugin.description: The first plugin in `plugins`, or `core` when the list is empty.

plugins.description: The plugins that own the listed rules, in catalogue order, each once.

categories.description: Every category the catalogue loads, in catalogue order. A filter on the rules does not shorten this list.

rules.description: The rules that pass the filters, in catalogue order.

CategoryOutput.description: A category as the listing shows it: the metadata of a category file without its rules and without `schema_version`.

plugin.description: The plugin that ships the category.

weight.description: Contribution to the overall score before any config override.

MatchKind.description: The kind of the rule's match, as `--kind` names it. It repeats `match.kind`.

EffectiveSeverity.description: The level a rule runs at after the configuration layers. The set is closed, because gate and score logic depend on these values. `off` means the configuration disables the rule, which a shipped rule never does.

RuleBody.description: The members that every rule entry carries. The rule members come from the authoring shape (rule.schema.json, `$defs/Rule`) with the qualified `id`; the schema reuses its member definitions, and its `id` and closing rule do not apply here. Not closed: a `$defs` that uses it closes the shape.

message.description: Shown on a finding. Names the fix, not the violation. {match} and {replacement} interpolate.

ai_signal.description: How strongly a finding indicates machine-written text.

allowlist.description: Literal strings that never fire, even when the match holds.

severity.description: The level the rule ships with.

category.description: The category that holds the rule.

plugin.description: The plugin that supplies the rule. It is the part of `id` before the colon.

severity_from.description: The configuration source that set the effective severity, such as `project slopvac.toml:4:1`. Present when the configuration set it, including to the level the rule ships with.

url.description: The documentation page of the rule. Absent when the rule has none.

ExplainOutput.description: The document that `slopvac explain RULE --format json` prints: a rule entry with `schema_version` and, when the rule has an exception, the comment that suppresses it.

suppression.description: The `slopvac-allow` comment that suppresses the rule, naming the rule and its first exception.
